Prompts

```
['run optical flow estimation on a directory of images using the RAFT model and save forward and backward flow fields', 'run optical flow computation on every Nth frame from an image directory using the --frame_step argument', 'warp an image using a given optical flow field with bilinear interpolation via cv2.remap', 'compute forward and backward consistency masks from paired forward and backward optical flow fields using a threshold', 'summarize the run_flow script which computes RAFT-based optical flow between consecutive frames and saves encoded flow PNGs and visualization JPGs']
```
